name: Human Eye (Cornea, Lens, Retina, Vitreous & Optic Nerve)
semanticDescription: Anatomical 3D model of the human eye showing 3 concentric tunics (outer fibrous sclera and clear cornea, middle vascular choroid, ciliary body, and iris with open pupil aperture, inner sensory retina with optic disc and macula lutea), crystalline biconvex lens, suspensory zonules of Zinn, transparent vitreous body, and optic nerve bundle.
simplifications: Quadrant cutaway removes anterior-superior-right section to expose concentric tunic layers and internal optical components for educational inspection
Suspensory zonules of Zinn represented as 32 discrete radial fibrous ligament bundles
Retinal blood vessels simplified to primary superior and inferior arterial and venous arcades

materials.look: Protective white outer fibrous tunic with subsurface scattering
Dark brown-black vascular melanin layer absorbing internal light scatter
Ciliary body muscular ring and ciliary processes
Pigmented hazel-blue iris diaphragm with central open pupil aperture
Pupillary sphincter margin surrounding the true open aperture
Clear biconvex crystalline lens with optical transmission (IOR 1.406)
Delicate fibrous suspensory ligaments of Zinn
Clear aqueous humor fluid in anterior chamber (IOR 1.333)
Warm orange-red sensory photoreceptor layer with subsurface scattering
Pale blind spot at emergence of cranial nerve II
Yellow macula lutea and central fovea depression
Cranial optic nerve bundle II with subsurface scattering

provenance.source: NCERT Class 10/11 Physics/Biology Benchmarks & Procedural Geometry
